name: attributes_by_sequence
note: ProductAttribute._order = 'sequence, id' (addons/product/models/product_attribute.py): the attribute list as the ORM orders it with variant creation mode, display type and active flag; all rows (active_test off)
source_sql: SELECT id, sequence, create_variant, display_type, active FROM product_attribute ORDER BY sequence, id

name: values_per_attribute
note: product.attribute.value_ids one2many (addons/product/models/product_attribute.py) embedded as productAttribute.value: values per attribute, with custom and active counts; attributes without values excluded on both sides
source_sql: SELECT attribute_id, count(*) AS values, count(*) FILTER (WHERE is_custom) AS custom_values, count(*) FILTER (WHERE active) AS active_values FROM product_attribute_value GROUP BY attribute_id ORDER BY attribute_id
